Reset multipliers

Puts every multiplier back to the values this tool ships with. Anything you added yourself is removed. Zones, prices and saved work are untouched.

Your data

Everything lives in this browser on this machine, pictures included. Nothing is sent anywhere. Export a backup before you replace the HTML file, or to move to another computer.

Load takes a backup, a rules pack or a map image and works out which it is — you can drop the file anywhere on the window. Spreadsheet writes your properties out as a CSV for Excel or Sheets.

Rules pack

Zones, price bands and multipliers only — no properties, clients or pictures. Send this to another realtor and their own work is left alone.

Start over

Wipes every property, client and picture on this machine. Zones and rules go back to defaults.

Updating the tool

When you're sent a newer copy of this file, just open it. Everything it needs is inside it, including the maps and the logo, so there is nothing to keep alongside it. Your saved work carries across untouched — the file holds the program, never the data.

New rules or zones added in an update appear automatically, but anything you edited yourself wins and is never overwritten.

. Save format . Older backups are converted on import.

Custom base map
